_comment: Source-of-truth registry for shared Jarvis KBs (see docs/kb-standards.md §6). Drives BOTH n8n ingestion and the chat agent's list_kbs/search_kb tools. Add a KB = add an entry here. All KBs embed with bge-m3 (1024-dim, Cosine) via LiteLLM.

kbs.name: kb_homelab_docs
kbs.description: Homelab infrastructure docs — the Docker stack services, deployment on the jarvis server, networking/Traefik/SSO, monitoring/alerting, and the AI stack (LiteLLM, Qdrant, n8n, OpenWebUI, ComfyUI). Use for questions about how the homelab is built, configured, or operated.

kbs.name: kb_example_app_docs
kbs.description: Markets engine documentation and design — system architecture, per-app and library docs, migration notes, and platform-services integration for the markets system. Use for questions about the markets engine's design, components, or how it uses the Jarvis platform.

kbs.name: kb_design_docs
kbs.description: Product and business design documentation — architecture, requirements, terminology/glossary, business and marketing material, and patents. Use for questions about product vision, requirements, business strategy, or defined terms.

kbs.name: kb_assistant-app_docs
kbs.description: Assistant app documentation — design, architecture, and usage docs for the Assistant application (README, CLAUDE.md, and the docs/ tree of the assistant-app repo). Use for questions about how Assistant works, its components, or its memory/KB conventions.

kbs.name: kb_content_curator_docs
kbs.description: content-curator app documentation — design, architecture, roadmap, setup/deploy, and the n8n harvest+ingest flow design for the Discord-to-KB curation bot (the 'Librarian'). Use for questions about how content-curator works, its pipeline, channels/links data model, or its components.

kbs.name: kb_topic_ai_ml
kbs.description: Curated AI/ML research — links (YouTube talks, articles, papers, repos, docs) harvested from the team's Discord AI/ML channels and credibility-filtered. Use for questions about AI/ML tools, models, agents, techniques, and notable resources the team is tracking.
kbs.pii_note: Discord-harvested: chunks may carry author handles/names of real people. No consent record and no per-source delete path yet — todos.md #44.

kbs.name: kb_web_app_public
kbs.description: PUBLIC example.com content — the corpus behind the public chat on example.com.
kbs.license: proprietary (Bleenq LLC) — published publicly on example.com
kbs.retention: indefinite (rebuilt from the site + OSS repo each ingest)
kbs._note: external=true: ingest/generation is OWNED by the web-app repo, deliberately isolated. Registered here so the shared registry is complete and the AI-BOM does not report it as an orphan collection. Do NOT add it to the shared ingest or the internal kb-chat agent.

kbs.name: kb_example_site_public
kbs.description: PUBLIC example-site.ai content — the corpus behind that site's public chat.
kbs.license: The Example Playbook™ — Bleenq LLC trademark; published publicly
kbs.retention: indefinite (rebuilt from the playbook bundle each ingest)
kbs._note: external=true, as above. Isolated from kb_web_app_public by decision (2026-07-14) — the Playbook bot must not reach Bleenq's corpus; asserted by the eval case playbook-cannot-reach-web-app-corpus.

_governance: Every KB carries owner/visibility/classification/license/retention/contains_pii. visibility is ENFORCED by docker/ai/n8n/build_kb_workflows.py: a corpus that is not `public` cannot be wired into a public-surface workflow, and an entry missing a required field fails generation. See docs/kb-standards.md section 6 and docs/ai-governance.md.
_visibility_values: public = internet-reachable via a public chat surface | internal = homelab users/agents only | restricted = internal AND commercially sensitive (business strategy, patents, markets design)
